sentences.text:
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----

For the Petitioner : Md. Shahid Yunus, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Achinto Sen, A.P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Pramod Kr. Jha, Advocate  ----
05/19.07.2023  Heard the parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sonarai thari P.S. Case No. 38/2022 arising out of Complaint Case No.718/2022, for the offences registered under Sections 323, 379, 498A, 313 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of Smt. Sandhya Prasad, learned J. M., Deoghar.
Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2.
Vide order dated 18.05.2023, at the request of opposite party No.2, the matter was referred to JHALSA for initiating mediation between the parties.
Report of Member Secretary, JHALSA is on the record.
From perusal of the report, it appears that the petitioner did not appear before Member Secretary, JHALSA as directed by this Court.

Mr. Pramod Kr. Jha, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party No.2 submitted that despite of the fact that opposite party No.2 was tortured and driven away from matrimonial home to enforce demand of Rs.1,50,000/- and motorcycle.
She is still ready to resume her matrimonial relationship in order salvage her marriage, but the petitioner is not ready to receive her back to their matrimonial home.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid fact, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on Anticipatory Bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for Anticipatory Bail of the petitioner stands rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
